aula.objetivo: Name the members of the family, tell «parenti» (relatives) apart from «genitori» (parents), use possessives with the right article (and without an article for a singular family member), and talk about your own family.

blocos.titulo: The family: gender, plural and false friends
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: most family words have a masculine in «-o» and a feminine in «-a»: «il nonno / la nonna», «il figlio / la figlia», «il cugino / la cugina», «lo zio / la zia». The plurals follow the rule of lesson 5: «i nonni», «le nonne», «le figlie». STEP 2: the masculine plural is used for a mixed group: «i nonni» (grandfather and grandmother, or grandparents), «i fratelli» (brothers, or brothers and sisters), «i figli» (sons, or sons and daughters), «gli zii» (uncle and aunt). English needs two words («siblings», «grandparents», «aunts and uncles»); Italian just uses the masculine plural. STEP 3: beware of «parenti»: it is a false friend. It means «relatives» (all family members, such as aunts, uncles and cousins), not «parents». Your parents are «i genitori». STEP 4: «nipote» serves for grandson, granddaughter, nephew and niece; the article shows the gender: «il nipote», «la nipote». Context settles the rest. STEP 5: «mamma» and «papà» are the names used in the family; «madre» and «padre» sound more formal or written. STEP 6: to say how many siblings you have, use «avere»: «Ho due fratelli e una sorella.» To say you have none, «Non ho fratelli». STEP 7: someone without siblings is «figlio unico» (male) or «figlia unica» (female). STEP 8: «sposato» and «sposata» (married) agree with the person: «Mio zio è sposato».
blocos.comparacao: «Parenti» is a false friend: it looks like English «parents», but it means «relatives». Your parents are «genitori». As in English «siblings», the masculine plural covers a mixed group («fratelli» = brothers, or brothers and sisters). Watch the double consonant: «nonno» is grandfather, but «nono» is the ordinal «ninth».

tabela.plural: i nonni (grandparents, or grandfather and grandmother)

erros.errado: I miei parenti sono mamma e papà.
erros.certo: I miei genitori sono mamma e papà.

blocos.enunciado: Say out loud how many siblings, aunts, uncles and cousins you have, and how old your grandparents or your parents are: «Ho… Mia nonna ha… anni.»
Review lesson 6: conjugate one -ere verb, one -ire verb and one -isc- verb out loud. Say two sentences with «avere» (hunger, thirst, sleepiness, cold or heat).
